full_page.content:
1934, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 284 Cont.
Dec. 27 Anthony Klosckner - 64 - operated on for cancer of liver - opera- tion abandoned as hopeless - That was Dec. Il two weeks ago. Still living and now home from hospital (Prov.) enrolled annually and then perpetually.
Joseph Raths - 19 - ruptured appendicitis adhesians - 3 opera- tions - last on X-mas.
Reported "improving since Frid'y night after enrollment.
28 30 Mrs. Dolores - 25 - husband & 1 of 2 yrs. Convulsions. Had oper- ation 13th of last March. Convulsions no better. Prayers for either happy death or speedy recovery.
Cecelia Brown - has four small children - flu - pneumonia ... . fears operation.
Dan Crowley 20 of Alpena, who broke his back and was enrolled a year ago when given up as hopeless came To-day in perfect health.
Margaret McCasey - 48 - heart - complications.
Page 285 Blank Page
January 1935 A.D. 1935, January
Page 286 1935 Jan. 3 "Father come to Detroit ... has bad feet.
A. Dubber ... (insists) persists keeping comapny with divorced man ...
4 Joanna LeDuc-5- Broken appendix - 1062 fever yesterday morning. .. at 7:15P.M. 104. .. Jan. 7th good day, Jan. 8 at 10:45 a.m. 107 fever.
Jos. Raths - 19 - operated on Thanksgiving and twice since that now extremely nerveous. St. Mary's Hospital.
6 Mr. Louise Potrykus - 71 - diabetis, gall-stones, yellow jandis, etc .- went to hospital To-day .... Jan. 9th operation To-day success- ful. Deo Gr.
10 Douglas Dunkan - 6 - sort of paralysis - never sat up or stood alone or spoke or plays. He smiles, however, and laughs - a beautiful child.
Mrs. Alice Donahue - 53 - operation 3 yrs. ago - inward cancer - fears its return.
11 Mrs. Fred DeLodder ... hurt her eye last May in a bush ... has been to 4 doctor including famous specialist in Niles, Mich. Fears losing her 16 sight. Enrolled To-day Jan. 16-Word about her To-day says she is perfectly O.K.
